purpose: Phase-7C Section 4 ENDOGENOUS checkpoint runtime coefficients (PD-1, PD-L1, PD-1/PD-L1 axis, CTLA-4). Represents checkpoint-mediated inhibition ALREADY PRESENT in the immune microenvironment - NOT therapeutic checkpoint blockade / anti-PD-1 / anti-CTLA-4 (those belong to later roadmap phases). PD-1 and PD-L1 stay separate component records; the axis is a registry-driven INTERACTION (not a naive product). CTLA-4 acts on priming separately from the PD axis (checkpoints are not interchangeable). Contributions target CD8/CD4 stages once each. Prediction-only; schematic [0,1].

axis.interaction_note: engagement = clamp(interaction_gain * (w_pd1*pd1 + w_pdl1*pdl1) * min(pd1,pdl1)^0, 0, 1) style bounded interaction - both components required; low ligand OR low receptor -> low engagement (not a plain multiply).

targets.note: PD axis and CTLA-4 target DIFFERENT stages; each contribution has a unique id so integrated suppression does not re-apply it.

coefficient_policy.source: general endogenous checkpoint biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: the axis requires BOTH PD-1 and PD-L1; no therapeutic blockade is modelled.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No receptor/ligand expression level; no checkpoint-inhibitor pharmacology (excluded).
